selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of disk-backed swap is active and preferred
selected_evidence.summary: `/swapfile` is a 536,870,912-byte regular file; `/proc/swaps` reports it active with 524,284 KiB usable capacity and priority 100.
The persistent fstab entry specifies priority 100. After reboot, `swapfile.swap` is active and the current-boot journal records its successful activation.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel were retained
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after the change, node1 reports CentOS Stream release 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was `4cee4ea8-4b8e-4c2f-af1a-3a82b9ec41f4`; reboot scheduling was acknowledged, the execution stream disconnected during restart, and node1 returned with boot ID `44eb7808-2a3d-42b5-901d-35348d61b322`. Post-restart system state is `running`, the swap unit is active, and its configuration and file metadata remain intact.
